name: MonarchAiErrorMessage
title: AiErrorMessage
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column on the MonarchBanner surface, with MonarchButton actions in a FlowRow and MonarchCollapsible for the details
summary: The failure card for an assistant turn: what went wrong in plain words, the actions that can fix it, an optional retry countdown and a technical details disclosure.
whenToUse: In place of, or at the end of, an assistant reply that failed: a rate limit, a conversation that is too long, a safety block, a lost connection or a failed tool.
whenNotToUse: For a failure outside an AI conversation use MonarchInlineErrorRetry or MonarchBanner. For a whole screen that failed to load use MonarchErrorState.
api: @Composable fun MonarchAiErrorMessage(modifier: Modifier = Modifier, kind: MonarchAiErrorKind = MonarchAiErrorKind.Unknown, title: String? = null, message: String? = null, details: String? = null, retryAfterMillis: Long? = null, retrying: Boolean = false, announce: Boolean = true, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchAiErrorMessageLabels = MonarchAiErrorMessageLabels(), onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, onEditPrompt: (() -> Unit)? = null, onSwitchModel: (() -> Unit)? = null, onNewConversation: (() -> Unit)? = null, onSummarize: (() -> Unit)? = null, actions: (@Composable FlowRowScope.() -> Unit)? = null)
enum class MonarchAiErrorKind { RateLimit, ContextOverflow, SafetyBlock, Network, ToolFailure, Unknown; companion object { fun fromCode(code: String?): MonarchAiErrorKind } }

class MonarchAiErrorMessageLabels(tone: String? = null, retry: String? = null, retryIn: ((seconds: Int) -> String)? = null, retryReady: String? = null, editPrompt: String? = null, switchModel: String? = null, newConversation: String? = null, summarize: String? = null, details: String? = null)

options.name: kind
options.description: Why the turn failed. MonarchAiErrorKind.fromCode maps a raw error code.

options.name: title
options.description: Replaces the built-in title of the kind.

options.name: message
options.description: Replaces the built-in description of the kind.

options.name: details
options.description: Technical information, shown in code type behind a disclosure.

options.name: retryAfterMillis
options.description: Time until a retry is allowed, counted from when the card appears.

options.name: retrying
options.description: Shows a progress indicator on the retry action.

options.name: announce
options.description: Announces the title and message when the card appears.

options.name: icon
options.description: An icon at the start of the card. Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the tone name, the action titles, the countdown text, the ready announcement and the details title.

options.name: onSummarize
options.description: Shows "Summarize and continue", for ContextOverflow only.

options.name: actions
options.description: Extra actions after the built-in ones.

states.name: kind
states.description: RateLimit, ContextOverflow and SafetyBlock use the warning tone; Network, ToolFailure and Unknown the danger tone. Each kind has its own title, description and action order.

states.name: counting down
states.description: The retry action is disabled and reads "Try again in 12s". Without onRetry the same text is shown as a caption.

states.name: retrying
states.description: The retry action shows a progress indicator, reads "Loading" and does not run.

states.name: details expanded
states.description: The technical details are shown in code type in a bordered box.

appearance: The surface of MonarchBanner: the subtle fill and the border of the warning or danger tone, the strong role of the tone for the icon, default text for the title and muted text for the description. The first action is a primary button, the others secondary. The details box is the surface role with the default border.
platformNotes: The parity map names MonarchBanner, but the banner takes one action and no extra content, so the card is drawn with the same tone palette and looks the same. The web's code prop is MonarchAiErrorKind.fromCode. title and message are Strings, and details is a String shown in code type. The many built-in strings are replaced through one labels value, as on iOS. The web draws action and kind glyphs; Monarch for Android bundles no icons, so the kind icon is a slot and the actions are text. The actions wrap in a FlowRow. retryAfter is milliseconds, as AiErrorPart's retryAfterMs; the countdown starts when the card appears and is updated every half second. The web announces through role=alert filled after mounting; Android fills an assertive live region after the first frame.
accessibility: The tone name, title and message are one TalkBack element, read as "Warning" or "Error", then the title, then the message.
Each action is a separate button with a 48dp touch target; the details disclosure header is 48dp high.
The title and message are announced once through an assertive live region after the card appears, unless announce is false.
"You can try again now." is announced through a polite live region when a countdown ends.
The tone is a spoken word as well as a color. The raw error code is never shown or spoken.
While retrying, the retry button reads "Loading" as its state and is reported as disabled.
edgeCases: Without handlers and without extra actions there is no action row.
onSummarize is ignored unless the kind is ContextOverflow.
A non-positive retryAfterMillis is no countdown.
A code that matches several rules takes the first: rate limit, then context, safety, tool, network.
Long titles, messages and details wrap; details keep their line breaks.

examples.title: Too many requests
examples.template:
MonarchAiErrorMessage(
    kind = MonarchAiErrorKind.fromCode({{code}}),
    details = {{details}},
    icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Clock, contentDescription = null) },
    onRetry = {},
    onNewConversation = {},
)
examples.code:
MonarchAiErrorMessage(
    kind = MonarchAiErrorKind.fromCode("http-429"),
    details = "code: http-429\nmessage: Too many requests.",
    icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Clock, contentDescription = null) },
    onRetry = {},
    onNewConversation = {},
)

examples.title: A rate limit with a countdown and details
examples.code:
MonarchAiErrorMessage(
    kind = MonarchAiErrorKind.RateLimit,
    details = "request_id: req_8f3a2c",
    retryAfterMillis = 12_000L,
    onRetry = {},
)
